question:
**Select the appropriate option to replace the underlined word with the adverb of time.**

I went to Paris __regularly__.
solution:
The correct answer is **yesterday**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct replacement of the underlined word with the **adverb** of time is '**yesterday**'.
